title: Delegation fan-in prompt carries each reviewer's full command and inspected-file lists
outcome: Reported by Engram::Fable (2026-09-27, mailbox-703fddd4 #2). The fan-in prompt queued to the parent includes every reviewer's complete Commands run and Files inspected lists (often 50+ entries each), while the parent needs findings, status and freeze verification. Request: the fan-in carries findings, status and freeze verification; the rest stays available through termal_get_session_result. Related: tm-9do (UI collapse of fan-in prompts), a different surface.
acceptance: The per-child section of a queued delegation completion fan-in retains status, summary, findings and recorded notes (including freeze verification and scope caveats), while replacing the typed Commands run and Files inspected lists with evidence counts; arbitrary notes beginning with 'Inspected' are retained.

The full recorded Commands run and Files inspected evidence remains available through termal_get_session_result using delegationId; the fan-in names that retrieval route and the outputOffset/outputLimit full-output paging route, and rendering its compact section does not mutate the stored result.
